title: 2027 Outlooks
summary: Explore the 2027 Outlooks from across Goldman Sachs, from specialists on the trading floor to economists and analysts from the global research team.
body_markdown:
#### Global Macro Outlook: Steady Baseline, Downside Risks


Goldman Sachs Research expects the global economy to grow 2.8% in 2027 as lower energy prices and strong AI capex outweigh tighter financial conditions.


[Read Report](https://www.goldmansachs.com/insights/goldman-sachs-research/global-macro-outlook-stead-baseline-downside-risks)


#### Global Markets Outlook: Growing Pains


Goldman Sachs Research outlines key investment themes set to drive markets in 2027, from a maturing cycle to bonds reclaiming hedging value.


[Read Report](https://www.goldmansachs.com/insights/goldman-sachs-research/global-markets-outlook-growing-pains)


#### Global Equity Strategy Outlook: Finding Value in Growth


Goldman Sachs Research sees the equity bull market continuing in 2027, with an overweight in US and Japan equities and an underweight in Europe.
